authorize.title: Authorize {client}
authorize.description: This app is requesting access to your Zyx Academy authoring workspace.
authorize.adminRequiredDescription: The authoring MCP server manages curriculum and content drafts, so only administrator accounts can access it. Your current account ({email}) does not have the admin role.
authorize.signInAdmin: Sign in with an admin account
authorize.readDescription: View course structure, published learning Ideas, and the question bank catalog.
authorize.stageDescription: Create and upload Idea Bundles, structured Article drafts, Diktat materials, and quiz questions.
authorize.reviewDescription: Evaluate 8 learning quality criteria and record draft review decisions.
authorize.withdrawDescription: Withdraw published material bundles and delete unpublished drafts.
authorize.unknownScopeDescription: Access the specified authoring MCP resources.
authorize.noPasswords: Cannot access your password or Google authentication data
authorize.noStudentData: Cannot view student personal information, grades, or activity
authorize.scopeBoundary: Access is limited to the permissions you select.
authorize.revoke: Sign out of your Zyx session to stop this integration’s access.
authorize.invalidRequestDescription: The authorization request must include response_type=code, code_challenge_method=S256, and a valid code_challenge.
authorize.unknownClientDescription: The client identifier (client_id) is unknown or the registration token format is invalid.
authorize.redirectMismatchDescription: The requested redirect URL (redirect_uri) does not match this client's registered redirect URLs.
authorize.targetMismatchDescription: The requested resource does not match the Zyx Academy authoring MCP endpoint.
authorize.invalidScopeDescription: One or more requested permission scopes are not supported by the Zyx authoring MCP gateway.
authorize.sessionInvalidDescription: Your session is invalid or has expired. Please sign in again.
authorize.metadataDescription: Authorize a Zyx Academy Model Context Protocol integration.
authorize.adminData: Response and user permissions can expose personal information.

shell.footerDescription: Zyx Academy. Model Context Protocol authoring gateway.
